previous_sweep.note: Prior sweep (feature-01 Super Series implementation) reported done with passing tests, but the operator demonstrated with screenshots that Super Series never activates in production. Per session contract, a new sweep is seeded with bug-73. Prior state preserved in git history.

bugs.title: Super Series never actually activates in production - the Settings toggle has NO WIRED HANDLER (set:superseries / set:superseries:on / set:superseries:off unmatched by any callback dispatch), so branding/super_series_settings.json is never written and every downstream Super Series path (prompt template, super-plan validator, queue controller) gates on a flag that can never become true
bugs.notes: Seeded per session contract. Confirmed root cause to verify against current code: bot/src/index.js emits three Super Series settings buttons (set:superseries, set:superseries:on, set:superseries:off) but no handler matches them. Fix: wire the three handlers (render screen with live state; on -> saveSuperSeriesSettings(...,true) + re-render; off -> saveSuperSeriesSettings(...,false) + re-render), trace the full tap chain from main Settings menu, then verify END TO END against the operator's two reported symptoms (prompt template dispatch; super-plan upload routing) with real persisted files, run all existing suites, and add tests covering the three callback_data values.
